## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link the relevant issue if one exists.

## Validation

Describe checks run and observed results. Distinguish mocked provider tests from live API or classroom checks.

## Review notes

Mention any migration, source/license change, privacy impact, or remaining limitation relevant to this change.

- [ ] No API keys, private configuration, student records, or private teaching material are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass and English/Chinese user-facing copy is updated where needed.
- [ ] New course content has verified answers, source references, and clear reuse rights.
- [ ] OpenMAIC attribution and upstream license notices remain accurate where applicable.
